description: This Java source file defines the class UnitsComboBoxRenderer, which customizes the rendering of a combo box within a table cell for ECU data units in the RomRaider project. It extends JComboBox and implements TableCellRenderer to display conversion options for logger data.

classes.name: UnitsComboBoxRenderer
classes.description: A custom table cell renderer that displays a JComboBox with ECU data convertors, selecting the current convertor based on LoggerData.

methods.name: getTableCellRendererComponent
methods.description: Returns a JComboBox populated with conversion options and sets the selected item based on the ECU data provided.
